definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese side dish where vegetables (and sometimes other ingredients) are mixed with a creamy dressing made from mashed tofu, sesame, miso, sugar, and soy sauce. A common item in home cooking and traditional set meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白和|しらあ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made spinach dressed with tofu.

examples.japanese: {白和|しらあ}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すり{潰|つぶ}して→すり潰す：17558_suritsubusu⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Shira-ae is made by mashing tofu.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{白和|しらあ}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{入|はい}っていて→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おいしい。
examples.english: My grandmother's shira-ae has lots of sesame in it and is truly delicious.

notes:
USAGE: {白和|しらあ}え is a standard dish in Japanese home cooking (⟦{家庭|かてい}{料理|りょうり}→家庭料理：17474_kateiryouri⟧). The name comes from ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (white, referring to the tofu) and ⟦{和|あ}える→和える：05824_aeru⟧ (to dress/mix). Common vegetables used include ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧ (spinach), {春菊|しゅんぎく} (garland chrysanthemum), ⟦こんにゃく→こんにゃく：04931_konnyaku⟧, and ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧ (carrot).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白和|しらあ}え: spinach dressed with tofu
- {白和|しらあ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣|ころも}→衣：14162_koromo⟧: the tofu dressing
- {白和|しらあ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make shira-ae
